svg.metadata: {"id": "s051", "name": "音乐教室", "cat": "艺术与劳动", "tags": ["音乐", "艺术", "合唱", "节奏"], "desc": "暖色音乐教室：两侧丝绒幕布、五线谱白板、立式钢琴、架子鼓和彩色木琴，音符会飘动。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [640, 1280]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "wall", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "staffboard", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "floor", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "curtains", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "piano", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.45, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "drums", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.55, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "cymbal_glint", "enter": "fade", "delay": 1.2, "loop": "twinkle", "depth": null}, {"name": "xylophone", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "notes", "enter": "pop", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "bob", "depth": null}, {"name": "spot", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "glow", "depth": null}], "palette": {"wall1": "#FFE7D6", "wall2": "#F8D2BF", "curtain": "#C8455A", "curtain2": "#A3354A", "gold": "#F2C14E", "floor1": "#B9744A", "floor2": "#9C5D38", "piano": "#2B2A33", "piano2": "#3E3C48", "key": "#FFFFFF", "board": "#FFFFFF", "staff": "#C9B6E4", "note": "#7A5CC4", "drum": "#4FA3D9", "drum2": "#2F7FB5", "skin": "#FFF6EA", "metal": "#C9CED6", "xylo1": "#F2836B", "xylo2": "#F7C55E", "xylo3": "#8ED081", "xylo4": "#5FB7E0", "xylo5": "#9B8CE8"}}
